method: Manual RAID log in Excel, timed with a start and end time, before the tool ran on these samples and without the answer files.
manual_accuracy: 23 of 23 expected items found with the correct type; 1 copy error (wrote 8% instead of 18%).
note: Manual times were measured on 2026-10-20 (s02: 17:32-17:40, s05: 17:46-17:52, s07: 17:57-18:03). These samples are short (about 140-160 words). Notes from a 1-hour call are much longer, so the manual time for a real call is higher. The charter's assumption of 20-40 minutes for a full call is not yet measured.
